findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment:
5-502.11: REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be removed from the PREMISES at a frequency that will minimize the development of objectionable odors and other conditions that attract or harbor insects and rodents. 

On arrival there is a large amount of waste observed filling and around the outside dumpsters. PIC (Kelly Corcoran) indicated that there has been a work order in for this situation for over a month. Records were checked and the first documented work order is dated June 14, 2023. Other dates observed include June 6th (continuing to be pushed back) and July 17. A roll off has been requested and is waiting on a supervisor (for the company/corporate). It was requested and initially approved for June 19th, but has not arrived. Trash service changed last month away from Waste Management due to an “account discrepancy.” At this time Waste Management is who Walgreens is going back to and Astor Company is not picking up as they agreed to in the interim. At this time the City of Springfield has already submitted a citation. Per CK, Food Program Supervisor, SCDPH will spot check in a week to check on compliance.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment: Observed several dented cans (Campbell's chicken noodle soup, pink salmon). Food packaging must be in good condition so that foods are not exposed to adulteration or potential contamination. CORRECTED- Cans were removed. Remind staff to remove dented cans, and of what sort of dents to look for.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 3-202.15 FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. (Pf)

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed 2 canned goods (olives), that were removed from the shelves, to be dented/damaged. Canned goods should be maintained in a sound condition that is free from damage that could break the seal. 
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the paper towel dispenser, in the women's restroom, to have the plastic part of the handle broken. This metal part that is exposed is soiled. This is not smooth and easily cleanable. Repair the hand towel dispenser.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the faucet closest to the door to have a leak from the base when the water is turned on. All plumbing should be maintained in good repair. Any repairs must be done by an Illinois licensed plumber. 
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the floors in the back dry storage area to be soiled with dust and debris under the "garbage only" door. 2) Observed the floor drain in the mop closet, that is between the two bathrooms, to have an accumulation of dirt and debris. Ensure that floors and drains are maintained in good repair, as well as in a clean state. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
